video_title: Melo Explains Why LeBron's Sixers Are Already Looking SCARY After Beating the Knicks

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia 76ers look surprisingly connected early in the season
quotes.excerpt: the Philadelphia 76ers look more connected than you expected them to be this early in the season

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: The Philadelphia 76ers look more connected than you expected them to be this early in the season, Game 1. I looked up at the scoreboard and LeBron James had like three points, two rebounds, three assists going into halftime. I looked at you and I said two things: one, once they get some shooters, it's going to be very, very scary to watch. And two, it can't be that. I was pointing at LeBron having three points. As soon as I said that, he hits a jumper, he gets a layup, first couple buckets in the third quarter. Anthony Davis gets a few open ones. He's doing his LeBron thing and getting easy buckets.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: I was not surprised with Tyrese, LeBron, Jalen. I actually thought Joel looked like he was trying to move faster. Trying, right? And I think that maybe I was like, okay, we'll see.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers' spacing makes them incredibly difficult to defend
quotes.excerpt: with some spacing, unbelievably hard to guard because nobody can be double-teamed
quotes.quote: I wouldn't say they looked more connected than I expected them to for Game 1. I would say that they looked like, with some spacing, unbelievably hard to guard because nobody can be double-teamed. LeBron James, even at his advanced age, you still have to give him special attention, he just draws it naturally. And you're just seeing open cuts from Brown, open cuts from Edgecombe. Joel Embiid is literally just prancing into free throw line jumpers and trailer threes. It's like, and that's with no spacing. That's with just all, you know, Maxey drives and Brown drives and all that type of stuff. Once they started hitting shots, I was like, they're going to be tough.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony evaluates the 76ers' roster and shooting capability
quotes.excerpt: they don't need shooters, they got capable shooters. Kentavious Caldwell-Pope is a vet, capable, lights out
quotes.quote: I wasn't watching like the shooting and all of that. Yeah, they, they don't need shooters, they got capable shooters. Kentavious Caldwell-Pope is a vet, capable, lights out, you know, could knock down the three consistently. Anthony Davis get hot, right? Maxey could shoot the three, right? LeBron going to get, he going to get stronger as the season goes on as far as like the game. You know what I mean? Them shots, he going to start making threes. Joel looks in great shape right now. Yeah, lost mad weight and in great shape.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the necessary role sacrifices for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: for LeBron to give Maxey those keys and take a step back, but don't even take a step
quotes.quote: For LeBron to give Maxey those keys and take a step back, but don't even take a step, he take a step to the side. I mean, I'm just going to figure it out. I'm going to take advantage of the mismatches. I ain't going to try to work that hard. I'm going to just set picks and I know how to, I know how to play at the five because I know how I want my fives to play with me. So now he gets a chance to just be creative and try to play, be that guy that he always wanted to, one of his bigs to be, with the skill set. And sacrifices is going to have to be made. Like, Jrue Holiday is going to have to sacrifice. Yeah, he's going to have to sacrifice. Joel is going to have to sacrifice.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid as a potential defensive weakness for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: if you want to find a possible weakness in that team, it might be Joel Embiid
quotes.quote: And that could be their one, like if you, if you want to find a possible weakness in that team, it might be Joel Embiid, because Andre Drummond comes off the bench, he has like, what, 10 and 12 in like five minutes.
